recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not restore the old explicit Provenance-only bullet for FHIR-12229 because later decisions deliberately generalized the rule. Handle FHIR-54514 separately if and when its R6 change-required decision is applied.
issue_request: FHIR-12229 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification Structured Documents clarification for DSTU2. It asked to replace wording that limited document-bundle Provenance to targets included in the Composition with wording allowing Provenance that targets the Composition itself or another resource included in the document.
initial_application: The issue was applied by e88780ca7bed60fb83ef49bfddd9b40217d5690f, matching the Jira comment that cited svn revision 13013. That commit changed source/documents.html from a target included in item #1 to a target of Composition or another resource included in the document.
additional_context: FHIR-39502 later rewrote the document-content bullets into the current graph-based rule, and FHIR-14033 later resolved no-change because that generic list already includes Provenance with resources referencing or referenced by document contents. The current Bundle graph-connected guidance explicitly notes reverse references such as Provenances that point to resources within the Bundle. FHIR-54514 is a later R6 Resolved - change required request for explicit Bundle-target Provenance guidance, but it is not Applied/Published and addresses a distinct whole-Bundle target case.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/documents.html still permits the seed scenario because a Provenance targeting the Composition or another document resource is supporting information in the graph of resources that reference the composition set; nearby text also says document bundles may include Provenance statements including signatures.
